items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: And on the same show, they had a drummer named Kid "Lips" Hackett.

ctx.x: It was like a... There was a big tent, you know, and they had to bring the chairs. They had their own equipment. In fact, they traveled...they had their own train cars that they traveled in; their own cars on the... They were really first-class. They were about the finest minstrel show out there, other than maybe the Leon Claxton and the Royal American Revue show that used to travel... They had a whole big circus, everything that traveled with that show. And he had spectacular revues, Leon Claxton. In fact, the…

But anyway, getting back to Silas Green, that's where I first heard Bessie Smith. And on the same show, they had a drummer named Kid "Lips" Hackett. And he was an act. He didn't play with the band. But he was an act on stage, and he stood up and played the drums. And he could do all kind
